title: Equality of sheaf maps with finite free source near a stalk
statement: Let Y be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], r a natural number, y∈V an open neighbourhood, and M,N sheaves of modules on V [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Suppose M is isomorphic to the restriction to V of the free rank-r module on Y [def-weil-pbc-free-module]. If maps f,g:M→N become equal after module pullback [def-pc-module-pullback] along V.fromSpecStalkOfMem y hyV, then for every open U≤V containing y there is an open W≤U containing y such that the direct restrictions of f,g from V to W are equal.

proof.text: Put x=(y,hyV) in V and let a=V.fromSpecStalkOfMem y hyV. Factor a as the spectrum of the inverse open-immersion stalk isomorphism followed by V.fromSpecStalk x. The canonical-morphism local-properties theorem makes the latter stalk map an isomorphism at every point; thus a.stalkMap at the closed point is an isomorphism. The closed point maps to x by fromSpecStalkOfMem_ι and fromSpecStalk_closedPoint.

Use the canonical tensor-pullback adjunction and Mathlib pullbackPushforwardAdjunction to identify their left adjoints. Naturality carries equality of Mathlib pullback maps to equality of tensorPullback maps. The natural tensor-pullback stalk comparison then gives equality after extension of scalars of the original module stalk maps. Restriction of scalars along the isomorphic ring stalk map is an equivalence, so the extend/restrict adjunction unit is an isomorphism. Naturality of that unit and cancellation yield equality of the original stalk maps. This is the proved private helper stalk_map_eq_of_pullback_eq.

Compose the assumed source isomorphism with the proved source-library restrictFreeIso to replace M by the finite free sheaf on V. Precompose the equality of stalk maps with each coproduct inclusion and evaluate on the germ of 1. Mathlib stalkFunctor_map_germ_apply gives equality of the germs of the two images of each global generator.

For each generator apply Mathlib TopCat.Presheaf.germ_eq to its two global images. Take the intersection of their finitely many open neighbourhoods with the inverse image of U in V. Mathlib Opens.coe_iInf ensures this intersection contains x, including an empty index type. Restrict each section equality to the common intersection. Restriction preserves the free coproduct, so its colimit hom_ext reduces equality of restricted maps to equality on each summand. Identify each restricted unit with the unit, and use unitHomEquiv and compatibility of sections to see that a map from the unit is determined by its value at global 1. These identities are proved in the private helpers unit_hom_ext_top and exists_restrict_eq_of_free_germs_eq.

Cancel the restricted inverse of the source isomorphism. Send the common neighbourhood Wprime inside V to W=V.ι image Wprime inside Y, proving W≤U and y∈W. Mathlib isoImage identifies Wprime.toScheme with W.toScheme; cancel V.ι to identify its composite with Y.homOfLE with Wprime.ι. Transport map equality along restrictFunctorCongr and restrictFunctorComp. Restriction along this scheme isomorphism detects equality, as shown by evaluating on inverse-image opens in the proved private helper restrict_map_injective_of_isIso. This yields exactly the direct restriction equality in the theorem.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_restrict_eq_of_pullback_eq
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (r : ℕ) (y : Y) (V : Y.Opens) (hyV : y ∈ V)
    (M N : V.toScheme.Modules)
    (hM : Nonempty (M ≅ (restrictFunctor V.ι).obj
      (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin r)))))
    (f g : M ⟶ N)
    (hfg : (Modules.pullback (V.fromSpecStalkOfMem y hyV)).map f =
      (Modules.pullback (V.fromSpecStalkOfMem y hyV)).map g)
    (U : Y.Opens) (hUV : U ≤ V) (hyU : y ∈ U) :
    ∃ (W : Y.Opens) (hWU : W ≤ U), y ∈ W ∧
      (restrictFunctor (Y.homOfLE (hWU.trans hUV))).map f =
      (restrictFunctor (Y.homOfLE (hWU.trans hUV))).map g
